pre_freeze_dry_runs_NOT_CANONICAL.description: Uncommitted scratch executions while implementing the runner, before the method freeze. Their outputs are not canonical V2-FL-005 evidence and were discarded.
pre_freeze_dry_runs_NOT_CANONICAL.full_demo_runs: two end-to-end engineering runs (cohort -> 3 rounds -> shadow -> restart) at max_weight=4096; restart exact match held in both
pre_freeze_dry_runs_NOT_CANONICAL.secagg_shadow_max_weight_4096: FAILED the 1e-4 tolerances in 4/4 dry runs (max abs ~1.0e-4, relative L2 ~2.2e-4): a workload-scale mismatch (client weights 83-93 vs max_weight sized for 1436-example real clients)
pre_freeze_dry_runs_NOT_CANONICAL.exploratory_max_weight_values: 1024, 256 and 128 were also executed in the same dry-run script (4 repetitions each) for information; 256 gave max abs ~0.7e-5 and relative L2 ~1.35e-5
pre_freeze_dry_runs_NOT_CANONICAL.decision: max_weight=256.0 chosen by the user's rule next_power_of_two(2 * max_client_examples_seen=93) from structural example counts only; not derived from any search over candidate values, aggregate error, logits, loss or metric

canonical_shadow_execution_note: The frozen compat binding is executed once per fresh-process full reproduction (two canonical full runs); no retries and no parameter changes. A failure in either is a STOP condition.
scenario_note: Round-3 duplicate injection necessarily follows the first accepted update of that client; injected stale/wrong-base/unknown envelopes are derived from valid round-3 envelopes by field mutation (frozen in the protocol).
